page.layout: One page: the outside of a binding (front board), with two metal clasp fittings on the left edge and raised bands on the spine at the right. No printed text.
page.notes: Front cover of a book in blind-tooled pigskin or calf, with decorative frame and centre panel impressions and remains of a light pale wash. Two brass clasp plates on the fore-edge side, with leather straps. Raised bands on the spine side. No title, label or printed text is visible on the cover, so nothing is transcribed. Dark background around the board is the scanning environment.
